principle: A successful parry can redirect the incoming line yet still incur support debt: the body braces asymmetrically, compresses into the rear support, peels the front support, spends the residual force through a curved unsupported lateral recoil, holds the consequence, earns a new address with one trustworthy exit-foot plant, then restacks with secondary lag and residual recovery debt instead of reversing to idle.
